name: How does a walk-in tub compare to a traditional shower installation in terms of renovation scope?

mainEntity.name: How does a walk-in tub compare to a traditional shower installation in terms of renovation scope?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a walk-in tub typically involves a more extensive renovation scope compared to replacing a traditional shower. A walk-in tub often requires specific structural support, more significant plumbing adjustments for its larger volume, and dedicated electrical circuits for features like jets or heaters. A traditional shower replacement might be less invasive. Our design-build approach helps homeowners weigh these practical tradeoffs, ensuring the chosen solution best enhances functionality, beauty, and value for their specific needs, whether it's a spa-style walk-in tub or an expansive custom shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in tub usually involves a more extensive renovation scope, requiring significant structural, plumbing, and electrical modifications compared to a traditional shower replacement.
